players.product: Polishing pads for semiconductor devices (CMP pads) and for silicon wafers (Polishing Pad Business)

quarterly_data.quarter: Fujibo Holdings annual securities report: FY2026 (06-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 (fiscal year ended March 31, 2026) consolidated results: net sales JPY 45,929 million, up JPY 3,016 million (7.0%) year on year; operating profit JPY 8,143 million, up 25.7%; ordinary profit JPY 8,356 million, up 25.2%; profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 5,612 million, up 25.4%. Management states that operating profit and net profit were both record highs and that Polishing Pad orders were firm on rising investment demand for AI-related advanced semiconductors and data centers.
quarterly_data.figure: JPY 45,929 million net sales (+7.0%); JPY 8,143 million operating profit (+25.7%); JPY 5,612 million net profit (+25.4%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Fujibo Holdings annual securities report: FY2026 (06-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Polishing Pad Business FY2026 by application (management's analysis): CMP pads for semiconductor devices - orders firm on rising demand for leading-edge logic semiconductors as generative AI spreads, sales up 26%; silicon wafer pads - demand for general-purpose products weak but advanced-product demand firm, sales flat year on year; LCD glass pads - orders rose on strong panel demand from China's home-appliance subsidy policy, sales up 33%; hard disk pads - data center demand continued, sales flat. Polishing Pad production JPY 19,770 million (+19.2%).
quarterly_data.figure: CMP sales +26%; LCD glass sales +33%; JPY 19,770 million Polishing Pad production (+19.2%)

quarterly_data.signal: The Taiwan subsidiary Taiwan Fujibo Precision Materials is building a polishing-pad R&D center in Zhunan, Miaoli County: total planned investment JPY 6,500 million (JPY 1,787 million already paid), started August 2024, completion planned April 2027.

quarterly_data.quarter: Fujibo Holdings annual securities report: FY2026 (06-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Medium-term management plan 'Shinka 26-30' (FY2026-FY2030, from April 2026): the company plans JPY 48.0 billion of capital expenditure over the five years and targets net sales of JPY 100.0 billion and operating profit of JPY 20.0 billion in fiscal 2035; fiscal 2030 targets also include ROE and ROIC of 12% or more.
quarterly_data.figure: JPY 48.0 billion capex over five years; fiscal 2035 targets JPY 100.0 billion net sales, JPY 20.0 billion operating profit

quarterly_data.quarter: Fujibo Holdings annual securities report: FY2026 (06-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management's review of the prior plan 'Zokyo 21-25': the targets of JPY 60,000 million net sales and JPY 10,000 million operating profit were not reached (FY2026 actual JPY 45,929 million and JPY 8,143 million), but ROE (11.3%) and ROIC (11.5%) beat the 10% targets; in the Polishing Pad Business the company advanced the construction of a technical development building, the expansion of production and analysis equipment and the construction of a Taiwan R&D center to strengthen customer support.
